# ShouldISpend

ShouldISpend is an educational financial decision-support website that helps users evaluate major purchases, recurring bills, life-stage expenses, debt pressure, savings tradeoffs, and household cash-flow decisions.

The site uses calculators and guides to help users compare spending decisions against income, savings, debt, emergency cushion, monthly flexibility, and long-term tradeoffs.

ShouldISpend is educational content. It is not professional financial, legal, tax, insurance, medical, estate, or funeral-director advice.

## Crawl preference

Public pages on ShouldISpend may be crawled for indexing, retrieval, AI search, analysis, summaries, recommendations, and site-quality feedback.

This includes crawlers and retrieval systems from OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google/Gemini, Meta AI, xAI/Grok, and other public search or AI systems that honor robots.txt.

Please respect canonical URLs, the sitemap, calculator page context, and page-level disclaimers.
